lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid extending from the branchial region to the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a distinct lattice of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible along the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, low-contrast circular points concentrated primarily along the leading edge and mid-section of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A linear high-intensity feature, consistent with a remora or ectoparasite, is attached to the mid-lateral flank posterior to the pectoral fin; minor irregularity is present on the trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the pectoral fin exhibits a significantly higher density of small, high-luminance spots compared to the primary lateral flank patterning.
